name: agentic-conventions
description: Cross-repo agent conventions: the agent-native repo blueprint, templates, and shared skills.

plugins.name: myconv
plugins.description: The agent-native repo blueprint, carried as payload, plus five skills: /myconv:apply-conventions to set up or audit a repo against it, /myconv:make-plan and /myconv:wrap-up for planning and end-of-thread provenance, and /myconv:clickup-pull and /myconv:clickup-report to sync work/ items with a ClickUp tracker (inert without one).
